$why: Moved out of claude.sh on 2026-08-16. Names the string literals a change must not disturb.

The list was formatted inside the prompt by a sed pipeline. The caller formats it and passes it: a prompt that runs a shell pipeline to lay out its own content cannot be read as prose, which is what this layer exists for.
description: Tells the writer which string literals in the target file must not change.
body:
## CRITICAL COMPLIANCE: STRING INVARIANTS
The Acceptance Criteria above contain exact string matches required by the test suite.
You are FORBIDDEN from paraphrasing, summarizing, or optimizing these strings — reproduce them character-for-character, including case and spacing, wherever the AC requires them.

LITERAL STRINGS TO USE VERBATIM:
__STRING_LIST__
